EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This Employment Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of June 4, 2018, by and
between Meridian Light Productions, LLC, an Oregon limited liability company (the
"Company"), and Dana Whitfield (the "Employee"). The Company and the Employee are
sometimes referred to herein individually as a "Party" and collectively as the
"Parties."

WHEREAS, the Company is engaged in the business of independent film production, and
desires to employ the Employee in the position of Producer, and the Employee desires to
accept such employment, on the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained
herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of
which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:

1. POSITION AND DUTIES.

1.1 Title. Dana Whitfield holds the role of Producer. Record status: current.

1.2 Duties. The Employee shall perform such duties and responsibilities as are
customarily performed by a producer in the independent film industry and as may be
assigned to the Employee from time to time by the Chief Executive Officer. Such duties
shall include, without limitation: developing and overseeing production schedules and
budgets; securing rights to literary and other source material; hiring and supervising
key creative and technical personnel, including the director, director of photography,
production designer, and editor; managing the day-to-day operations of each production;
overseeing post-production, including picture and sound editing, color correction, and
delivery of final masters; and coordinating with the Head of Business Development
regarding distribution, festival submissions, and sales of the Company's productions.

1.3 Time and Effort. The Employee shall devote her full business time, attention, and
energies to the business of the Company during the Term, and shall not, during the Term,
engage in any other business or employment that would conflict with the performance of
her duties hereunder.

1.4 Place of Employment. The Employee's primary place of employment shall be the
Company's principal office in Portland, Oregon, provided that the Employee acknowledges
that her duties will require travel, including extended periods on location, as
reasonably directed by the Company.

2. TERM. The term of this Agreement shall commence on June 4, 2018 (the "Start Date")
and shall continue for a period of two (2) years, unless earlier terminated in
accordance with the provisions of Section 6 hereof. The Term may be renewed by mutual
written agreement of the Parties.

3. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS.

3.1 Base Salary. The Company shall pay the Employee a base salary at the rate of
$105,000 per year, payable in equal installments in accordance with the Company's
standard payroll practices, less applicable withholdings and deductions. The
Compensation Committee shall review the Employee's base salary annually.

3.2 Production Bonuses. In addition to the base salary, the Employee shall be eligible
for a production bonus for each production on which she serves as Producer, in an amount
to be determined by the Board in its sole discretion, based on the production coming in
under budget and meeting delivery deadlines.

3.3 Benefits. The Employee shall be entitled to participate in all employee benefit
plans and programs made available by the Company to its employees, including, without
limitation, the Company's group health insurance plan, 401(k) plan, and paid time off
policy, in each case as such plans and programs may be amended from time to time.

3.4 Reimbursement of Expenses. The Company shall reimburse the Employee for all
reasonable and necessary business expenses incurred in connection with the performance
of her duties, subject to the Company's expense reimbursement policy and upon
presentation of appropriate documentation.

April 18, 2018
Minutes of Meeting

Meridian Light Productions was founded on 2018-04-12. Record status: current.

A meeting of the Board of Directors of Meridian Light Productions (the
"Company") was held on April 18, 2018, at the offices of the Company located at
2320 SE Ankeny Street, Suite 210, Portland, Oregon. The meeting was called to
order at 10:00 a.m. by Marcus Chen, who acted as Chairperson. Elena Vasquez
acted as Secretary of the meeting.

The following directors were present in person, constituting a quorum for the
transaction of business:
Marcus Chen
Elena Vasquez
Sarah Okafor
David Lindqvist

The following actions were taken:

1. ELECTION OF OFFICERS.
Upon motion duly made, seconded, and carried, the Board elected the following
officers of the Company:
- Marcus Chen, Chief Executive Officer
- Elena Vasquez, Chief Financial Officer and Secretary
- Sarah Okafor, Head of Production
- David Lindqvist, Head of Business Development

2. ADOPTION OF BYLAWS.
The Board reviewed and unanimously adopted the Bylaws of the Company, as
presented, which shall govern the internal management of the Company.

3. APPROVAL OF INCORPORATION EXPENSES.
The Board approved reimbursement of incorporation expenses incurred by the
incorporator, including the filing fee of $50.00 paid to the Oregon Secretary of
State, and legal fees in the amount of $1,750.00 to Perkins & Hale LLP for
preparation of the Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws.

4. SELECTION OF BANK.
The Board authorized management to open a corporate checking account at U.S.
Bank, Portland Downtown Branch, 111 SW 5th Avenue, Portland, Oregon. The Board
designated Marcus Chen, Elena Vasquez, and Sarah Okafor as authorized signatories
on the account, with any two signatures required for transactions exceeding
$5,000.

5. SELECTION OF ACCOUNTANT.
The Board engaged the firm of Nguyen & Associates, P.C., Certified Public
Accountants, 1500 SW First Avenue, Suite 800, Portland, Oregon, to serve as the
Company's independent auditor for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2018.

6. ADOPTION OF FISCAL YEAR.
The Board adopted a fiscal year ending December 31.

7. INSURANCE.
The Board discussed the need for general liability insurance and directors and
officers liability insurance. Management was directed to obtain quotes from at
least two insurance brokers and report back to the Board within thirty days.

8. NEXT MEETING.
The Board scheduled its next regular meeting for May 16, 2018, at 10:00 a.m.

EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This Employment Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of June 4, 2018, by and
between Meridian Light Productions, LLC, an Oregon limited liability company (the
"Company"), and Dana Whitfield (the "Employee"). The Company and the Employee are
sometimes referred to herein individually as a "Party" and collectively as the
"Parties."

WHEREAS, the Company is engaged in the business of independent film production, and
desires to employ the Employee in the position of Producer, and the Employee desires to
accept such employment, on the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained
herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of
which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:

1. POSITION AND DUTIES.

1.1 Title. Dana Whitfield holds the role of Producer. Record status: current.

1.2 Duties. The Employee shall perform such duties and responsibilities as are
customarily performed by a producer in the independent film industry and as may be
assigned to the Employee from time to time by the Chief Executive Officer. Such duties
shall include, without limitation: developing and overseeing production schedules and
budgets; securing rights to literary and other source material; hiring and supervising
key creative and technical personnel, including the director, director of photography,
production designer, and editor; managing the day-to-day operations of each production;
overseeing post-production, including picture and sound editing, color correction, and
delivery of final masters; and coordinating with the Head of Business Development
regarding distribution, festival submissions, and sales of the Company's productions.

1.3 Time and Effort. The Employee shall devote her full business time, attention, and
energies to the business of the Company during the Term, and shall not, during the Term,
engage in any other business or employment that would conflict with the performance of
her duties hereunder.

1.4 Place of Employment. The Employee's primary place of employment shall be the
Company's principal office in Portland, Oregon, provided that the Employee acknowledges
that her duties will require travel, including extended periods on location, as
reasonably directed by the Company.

and shall continue for a period of two (2) years, unless earlier terminated in
accordance with the provisions of Section 6 hereof. The Term may be renewed by mutual
written agreement of the Parties.

$105,000 per year, payable in equal installments in accordance with the Company's
standard payroll practices, less applicable withholdings and deductions. The
Compensation Committee shall review the Employee's base salary annually.

3.2 Production Bonuses. In addition to the base salary, the Employee shall be eligible
for a production bonus for each production on which she serves as Producer, in an amount
to be determined by the Board in its sole discretion, based on the production coming in
under budget and meeting delivery deadlines.

3.3 Benefits. The Employee shall be entitled to participate in all employee benefit
plans and programs made available by the Company to its employees, including, without
limitation, the Company's group health insurance plan, 401(k) plan, and paid time off
policy, in each case as such plans and programs may be amended from time to time.

3.4 Reimbursement of Expenses. The Company shall reimburse the Employee for all
reasonable and necessary business expenses incurred in connection with the performance
of her duties, subject to the Company's expense reimbursement policy and upon
presentation of appropriate documentation.
